en.flavor: A replica of the famed sword of Arundolyn, the Lion of Light. Feel the power of a legendary hero as you hold this sword in your hand! Imagine yourself as the great warrior himself! Note: Daydreaming not recommended in live combat.

refinements.1: When HP falls below <r>70%</r>, increases Charged Attack DMG by <r>30%</r> and Charged Attacks become harder to interrupt.
refinements.2: When HP falls below <r>75%</r>, increases Charged Attack DMG by <r>35%</r> and Charged Attacks become harder to interrupt.
refinements.3: When HP falls below <r>80%</r>, increases Charged Attack DMG by <r>40%</r> and Charged Attacks become harder to interrupt.
refinements.4: When HP falls below <r>85%</r>, increases Charged Attack DMG by <r>45%</r> and Charged Attacks become harder to interrupt.
refinements.5: When HP falls below <r>90%</r>, increases Charged Attack DMG by <r>50%</r> and Charged Attacks become harder to interrupt.

fr.flavor: Une imitation de la célèbre épée d'Arundolyn, le Lion de la Lumière. Libérez le héros légendaire qui sommeille en vous ! Remarque : Ne rêvassez pas trop.

refinements.1: Les attaques chargées sont plus difficiles à interrompre si les PV sont inférieurs à <r>70 %</r>, et les DGT infligés par les attaques chargées augmentent de <r>30 %</r>.

refinements.4: Les attaques chargées sont plus difficiles à interrompre si les PV sont inférieurs à <r>85 %</r>, et les DGT infligés par les attaques chargées augmentent de <r>45 %</r>.
